scenes.text: You probably think of the Sahara Desert as a massive, lifeless ocean of burning sand, but beneath those scorching dunes lies an ancient secret that is about to change our entire planet.

Every twenty thousand years, Earth’s tilt shifts ever so slightly, rewriting the weather patterns and transforming this hot desert into a magical, green paradise filled with flowing rivers and exotic wildlife.
We are already halfway through the current cycle, and scientists are starting to see the first signs of this green awakening that will rapidly transform Africa.
Imagine standing in a blooming rainforest where a dry desert once stood, so would you want to live to see a mysterious green Sahara, and if so, hit follow and let me know below.
